menu.about: How safe is this web app?
menu.unpairText: This phone forgets the computer, together with its drafts and what you sent. To use it again, run `agentj pair` on the computer and pair again.

badge.label: Web app
badge.title: How safe is this web app?
badge.p1: What goes between your phone and your computer is encrypted. Our servers can't read it.
badge.p2: This web page itself, though, is loaded from our servers: if someone changed it, they could see what you see here. The phone app we're planning won't have that problem.
badge.hash: This page's version number (for checking it hasn't been changed):
badge.verify: How to check it, and what we keep, is on the Data security page: agentj.app/security/
badge.p3: Drafts and what you sent are kept on this phone only, encrypted; read-aloud uses the phone's own voices and sharing uses the phone's own share sheet.

st.awaiting: Waiting for your computer to approve
st.revoked: This phone was removed by your computer

pair.title: Connect to your computer
pair.lead: Your Agent works on your computer; this phone is its remote. No sign-up or login — pair once and it's ready whenever you open it.
pair.step1: On your computer, run `agentj pair`. A QR code appears on screen.
pair.step1ios: On your computer, run `agentj pair --link`. It prints a pairing link.
pair.step2: Tap Scan QR code, or paste the pairing link below.
pair.step2ios: Get that link onto this phone, copy it and paste it below.
pair.step3: Your phone shows a 6-digit code. Type it on your computer, then enter your approval passphrase.
pair.iphone: On iPhone, add this page to your Home Screen and open it there. Use Scan QR code here or paste the link. The system Camera opens a separate Safari tab.
pair.scanHint: Camera scanning is unavailable. Paste the pairing link below.
pair.scanNoCam: Camera access was denied or no camera is available. Allow access or paste the pairing link below.
pair.placeholder: Paste the link from agentj pair --link
pair.badLink: That link is invalid or has expired. Run agentj pair on your computer again.
pair.wiped: This browser deleted the pairing it had saved on this phone (for example a private tab was closed, or the browser cleared website data). Your computer did not remove this phone. Run `agentj pair` on the computer and pair once more. On iPhone, don't use Private Browsing; better, add the page to your Home Screen and open it from the icon.
pair.already: This phone is already paired with this computer, so you can carry on.

sas.title: Type this 6-digit code on your computer
sas.lead: Type these 6 digits on your computer, press Enter, then enter your approval passphrase.
sas.note: The code is only shown on this phone. Once your computer approves, the chat opens here by itself.

estop.bannerNote: Your Agent won't take new messages, pending approvals were denied, and scheduled tasks are paused.
estop.confirmText: This ends what your Agent is doing right now, denies every pending approval, cancels batch approvals and pauses all scheduled tasks. It won't take new messages until you tap Resume.
estop.resumeText: Your Agent takes messages again, and scheduled tasks go back to their own on/off settings.

mem.title: What it remembers
mem.intro: Your Agent reads these notes every time it starts work. They live on your computer. Delete any item: it goes to the trash on your computer first, and you can undo for 7 days.
mem.sources: Where {agent} keeps its memory (only these places):
mem.delText: It goes to the trash on your computer first. You can undo for 7 days.

act.intro: This record lives on your computer and is kept for 30 days.
act.off: Activity recording is off on your computer. Run agentj config activity on there to turn it on.

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.intro: These are things your Agent can do on a schedule. You decide which ones run; after a task changes, turn it on again.

revoked.title: This phone was removed by your computer
revoked.lead: Your computer no longer trusts this phone. To keep using it, run `agentj pair` on your computer and pair again.
revoked.draft: Your unsent draft, your input history and the key that encrypted them were deleted from this phone.
revoked.replacedLead: Continue in the Home Screen app or browser you just connected. This side has disconnected; you do not need Face ID recovery again.

error.title: Disconnected
error.pairBad: The pairing data didn't check out, so we disconnected. Run agentj pair on your computer again.
error.dataBad: Received data that couldn't be verified, so we disconnected to protect your conversation.

a2hs.title: Add it to your Home Screen to use it like an app
a2hs.ios: In Safari, tap the Share button at the bottom, then Add to Home Screen. Then open it from the Home Screen and pair there — lock-screen alerts also only work from the Home Screen app.
a2hs.android: In Chrome, tap ⋮ at the top right, then Add to Home Screen or Install app.
a2hs.openInstalled: If already added to your Home Screen, open its icon. Safari and the Home Screen app keep separate pairing records.

set.title: Settings
set.langNote: This is the only language setting: the app, the emails we send you and the way Agent J talks to you all use it. Your computer and your account pick up the change.
set.fontNote: Only the text in reply cards, saved on this phone only.
set.fontSample: Done. The list is in restock.md, grouped by supplier.
set.speakNote: Every new reply is read out as soon as it arrives.
set.wakeNote: Say the wake word to start talking. Works in the Agent J Android app only, not in this web app.
set.pushStateOn: On. Alerts never include what was said.
set.pushStateNo: This browser doesn't support lock-screen alerts.
set.pushStateDenied: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then come back and turn this on.
set.pushStateIos: On iPhone, add this page to your Home Screen first and open it from there.
set.refreshNote: After the web app is updated, tap this to fetch the new version, clear old caches and reopen.
set.refreshFail: Couldn't reload. Close this page and open it again.
set.a2hsNote: Once added, it opens like an app and can show lock-screen alerts.
set.a2hsDesktop: In your browser's menu, choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
set.a2hsAccepted: Added. Look for the Agent J icon on your Home Screen.
set.iosTitle: Add to Home Screen on iPhone
set.ios1: In Safari, tap the Share button at the bottom.
set.ios2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
set.ios3: Tap Add at the top right. From now on, open it from the Agent J icon on your Home Screen.
set.keysNote: Press ? on the chat screen to open it too.
set.computerNote: This phone pairs with one computer at a time. To rename the Agent, run `agentj name <new name>` on the computer. All your Agents are listed in the account dashboard.
set.computerSeats: See all Agents in the account dashboard
set.riskNote: Extra high-risk warnings are off by default. Change them here; AI coding tool permissions always apply.
set.modeNote: Tap to switch shared or independent sessions. Shared mode keeps the existing desktop session permissions.
set.isoNote: On: an Agent in an independent session can't see Agent J's keys or pairing data. Off: it runs with the AI coding tool's own permissions. Applies the next time the Agent starts.
set.dockerNote: Off by default. On: the isolated Agent can use docker / podman, and containers can mount any file on the computer.
set.readOnly: The program on this computer can't take settings from the phone yet. To change it, run this on the computer:
set.offline: Connect to your computer to change this.
set.accountNote: Payments, invoices, invite codes and points are in the account dashboard.
set.helpNote: If something goes wrong, tell Agent J "I want to send feedback". It shows you exactly what it will send, and sends it only after you say yes.

set.updatesSecurity: Urgent security fixes upgrade immediately, then explain why.

phoneEnv.ios: Open in Safari from the top-right menu, use a regular window, then Add to Home Screen. Pair and set up Face ID from that icon; use it every time. Allow cookies and website data.
phoneEnv.android: Open in Chrome from the top-right menu, use a regular window, then Add to Home Screen. Pair and set up screen unlock from that icon; use it every time. Allow cookies and website data.
phoneEnv.desktop: This browser may not retain pairing or support device unlock. Use a regular window in an up-to-date browser and allow cookies and website data.
phoneEnv.copied: Page link copied; pair from the Home Screen icon.

phoneEnv.iosAuth: If Face ID is unavailable, check iOS Settings → General → AutoFill & Passwords: enable AutoFill Passwords and Passkeys and select Passwords. Check iCloud → Passwords (Keychain), Face ID & Passcode, and restrictions in Screen Time or device-management profiles. Each scan or pairing-link tap creates a new pairing; after pairing, open the same Home Screen icon.
